breakout.summary: Buys a close above the prior 20-day high on above-average volume, and sells a close below the prior 10-day low.
breakout.title: Breakout

crossover.summary: Buys when the 5-day average crosses above the 20-day average and sells when it crosses back below.
crossover.title: Moving-average crossover

crossoverEMA.summary: Buys when the 5-day average crosses above the 20-day average and sells when it crosses back below.
crossoverEMA.title: Moving-average crossover

cryptoMonitor.summary: Watches crypto around the clock and signals when price is above a rising 21-day average.
cryptoMonitor.title: Crypto trend monitor

dca5.summary: Buys a fixed amount of each asset on a regular schedule, whatever the price.
dca5.title: Dollar-cost averaging

meanReversion.summary: Buys sharp dips (RSI under 30 and below the lower Bollinger band) and sells when price recovers to its average.
meanReversion.title: Mean reversion

momentum.summary: Buys assets that are rising and above their 50-day average, and steps aside when the rise fades.
momentum.title: Momentum

protections.summary: Buys above the 10-day average and leaves on any protective exit.
protections.title: Every protection

riskManager.summary: Guards a portfolio's open positions with a stop loss and a trailing stop. It never opens a position.
riskManager.title: Risk manager

trend.summary: Holds assets while their 20-day average is above their 50-day average.
trend.title: Trend following
